subject: Renewal & Expansion — pricing follow-up and volume step-ups (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>, Priya Chopra <pri.chopra@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & Expansion — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks again for your time today, Sam and Priya — great conversation walking through the renewal timing and the new routes you want to add for summarization and clinical QA. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Volumes: current monthly consumption = ~30M tokens. With the proposed expansion (additional summarization + new clinical QA routes), you estimated an incremental ~70M tokens/month, so target combined steady-state ~100M tokens/month.
- Budget/band: you shared a rough target budget range of $8k–$12k/month for the expansion initially (you mentioned finance would target low double-digit k), which maps roughly to $96k–$144k/year. We discussed aiming for unit economics at or under $X per 1M tokens — I noted we'd need to model blended rates across routes/models.
- Target $/1M tokens: you said procurement prefers seeing per-1M comps; we proposed a baseline list rate and step-downs at volume thresholds (see attached pricing sheet).
- Step-ups & blended pricing: proposed tiers at 0–50M, 50–200M, 200M+ with blended rates for committed volumes. We agreed to surface a renewal + expansion proposal that includes: (a) renewal term pricing, (b) committed volume discounts for expansion, (c) option for new-route add-on with a per-route seat/throughput surcharge.
- Technical: Rishi to confirm model selection (Redwood-rlm-13B quantized for summarization; smaller quantized model for QA) and expected latency SLOs per route.

Next steps:
1) Rishi will share an initial per-1M token pricing calculation (blended) and a sensitivity table for different splits between summarization vs QA (ETA: Thu 3/12).
2) I'll put together the renewal + expansion commercial (term, committed volumes, blended rates) and provide 2 options (50% commit and 100% commit) by Mon 3/15.
3) Priya to share the finance contact and any procurement template or preferred PO cadence.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-q1-2026.xlsx (pricing sheet with tiered examples), ACME_Milestones_MAPP_v2.pdf (your updated milestones doc you sent during the call).

If any of the bullets above need correction, call it out — otherwise I'll follow up with the commercial options on Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>, Priya Chopra <pri.chopra@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — post-call recap and next steps

Hi all — quick pricing math attached (see redwood-pricing-sheet-q1-2026.xlsx). Key assumptions called out in sheet but summarized here: 

- Assumed token mix: 70% summarization (avg length 400 tokens per request), 30% QA (avg length 120 tokens/request).
- Current steady-state (no expansion): 30M tokens/month. Expansion incremental = 70M tokens/month.
- List baseline: $40 / 1M tokens (hosted list).
- Proposed committed tiers (example blended outcomes):
  * 0–50M: $35 / 1M
  * 50–200M: $22 / 1M
  * 200M+: $15 / 1M
- For a 100M/month commit with a 12-month term, blended comes to ~$24 / 1M (~$2,400 per 100M => $2.4k? Wait math check). See sheet for line-level math; the blended takes weighted average across tier volumes.

Important note on unit economics: the per-1M metric can be misleading if you shift model mix — the summarization route (larger sequence lengths) has higher per-token cost on GPUs; we included model-specific multipliers in the sheet.

Next steps: Marissa — when you draft the two commercial options, can you include an example blended monthly invoice for each option (shows committed discount + overage rate)? Also flag any SLAs we should commit to on latency.

Thanks,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 08:05 AM Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Hey Rishi/Marissa — thanks for the context + the early math. Couple clarifications from our side:
> 
> - The 70M incremental is our rough ops estimate; it could be +/- 20% depending on adoption. We need a model that still makes sense at 80M total and at 120M total.
> - Finance preference is to see target cost expressed as $/1M tokens after blended discounts; ideally we want to be in the $18–$25 / 1M range at 100M/month committed.
> - Procurement: we typically do a 1-year renewal with options to renew; they also asked for a POable SOW and a standard net-45 term. We'll send their procurement template to procurement@acmehealth.com.
> 
> Sam
>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — pricing follow-up and proposed options

Sam — looping in Lauren from Customer Success to capture milestones and support SLAs. Per our agreement, attached are two commercial options: Option A (50% commit) and Option B (100% commit). High level: 

Option A — 12 mo term, 50% commit (avg 60M/month): blended $28 / 1M tokens, overage at $32 / 1M. Includes one free route add-on (summarization) and 10% off additional routes.

Option B — 12 mo term, 100% commit (100M/month): blended $20 / 1M tokens, overage at $22 / 1M. Includes two free route add-ons and priority support.

We also included an example invoice showing monthly blended charge and a breakout by route/model. Rishi — we used your multipliers but let us know if you want any adjustments before we send officially to procurement.

Next operational steps for Acme Health to close: 
- Priya / procurement to send PO template and target sign date.
- Finance to confirm target budget band and internal approvers.
- If you want a separate SLA for the clinical QA route (latency 300ms p95), we can add as an Appendix.

If this looks correct I'll draft the SOW + POable documents and send to procurement@acmehealth.com and the DocuSign link for signature.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion — pricing follow-up and proposed options

Thanks, Marissa. This is very helpful and close to what finance wants to see. Quick answers: 

- Finance confirmed target band of $90k–$130k / year for the expansion line item (so roughly $7.5k–$10.8k/month). Option B at blended $20 / 1M puts us at ~$24k/month for 100M (this is outside our initial band) — we need to either reduce spend or negotiate an adjusted blended rate for a committed 12-month term + upfront payment.
- Procurement sent the PO template to procurement@acmehealth.com (you should receive it soon). Net-45 is acceptable; they prefer an invoice schedule with monthly billing.
- Can you provide an alternative with an upfront prepay discount (annual prepay) or a two-tier blended (first 6 months at slightly higher rate, back-loaded credits)? That helps our CFO.

Priya
Procurement, Acme Health
